cards.title: Determinantal Point Processes for Machine Learning

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: ToMe是贪婪二部相似合并，slots是竞争聚类，OTKE是质量守恒匹配；DPP直接建模整组子集的行列式概率。与本lane的facility-location同属选集，但体积排斥不等于覆盖收益的递减。已核对撤回的experiments/osram_readout20_20261003/CANDIDATES.zh.md：DLRM/pair-dot和BAN双线性attention都没有对有限子集行列式归一化；本项不能退化为它们。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Hyperbolic Neural Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: SPDNet 对协方差做 BiMap/ReEig/LogEig；本项对一阶角色向量在负曲率球上执行基点依赖 gyrovector 运算，无协方差谱层、coupling 或 attention。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: BernNet: Learning Arbitrary Graph Spectral Filters via Bernstein Approximation

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 旧项学习 restriction/receiver-conditioned diffusion/边门控；本项在固定语义 Laplacian 上学习全局频率响应，允许抑制中间频带而保留差异。与下项 scattering 也不同：本项输出线性谱滤波响应，scattering 保留多阶 modulus 路径系数。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Diffusion Scattering Transforms on Graphs

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 不是学习更多传播层；固定wavelet-bank、多路径模值解调和各阶摘要是完整机制，区别于Sheaf传输及BernNet单次可学习谱响应。不能把不同wavelet家族另算候选。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Direct Parameterization of Lipschitz-Bounded Deep Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: DEQ以收缩约束保证固定点并隐式反传，本项无固定点或内循环；SPDNet正交BiMap用于SPD几何，本项Cayley与Psi共同实现前馈函数类的敏感性约束。不是给原MLP换一个激活函数。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Old spline module is an alternating invertible coordinate coupling conditioned on the untouched half. KAN is a noninvertible multivariate function decomposition by edge-specific functions and nested sums, without coupling masks, density Jacobians, or adaptive feature selection.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Deep Lattice Networks and Partial Monotonic Functions

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: NODE enumerates products of learned threshold decisions along oblivious-tree paths; DLN evaluates local multidimensional interpolation cells with vertex parameters and composes calibrated lookup tables. It is not a tree-depth change or invertible univariate spline coupling.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: NLM propagates predicates across arities using variable permutations and exists/forall reductions; this circuit instead learns truth-table operators in fixed sparse wiring with no quantifiers or object tuples. novelty_audit.substantive_difference: DEQ求z=f(z)并解固定点伴随；EA最小化聚合势能；这里求指定初值的有限时间非平衡轨迹，允许旋转等非梯度场。必须保留数值误差控制或明确solver，否则可能只是更多层。

cards.title: Janossy Pooling: Learning Deep Permutation-Invariant Functions for Variable-Size Inputs

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Exact group averaging of noncommutative recurrent whole-set compositions is not RRN's graph message recurrence, MAC's learned control/read/write, or FSPool's per-feature sorting. cards.title: Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning with Differentiable Pooling

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: The learned adjacency itself is coarsened and drives the next graph stage. GMT/TokenLearner compress features via seeds/tokens without S^T A S graph hierarchy; ToMe merges selected pairs rather than assigning all nodes to jointly learned soft clusters. Only S-pooling without the coarsened-graph stage would fail the novelty requirement.

cards.title: Nested Graph Neural Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: A node has multiple separately evolving copies conditioned on different roots; induced edges among its neighbors are retained before inner computation. Existing message passing has one state per node and a rooted computation tree, while PPGN has a pair tensor with matrix products. This is not replacing a graph convolution or increasing hop count.

cards.title: Graph U-Nets

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Hierarchical hard node selection plus connectivity augmentation, index-preserving unpool and graph decoder is distinct from DiffPool soft S^T A S, ToMe pairwise merging and FSPool per-channel ranking. A scalar gate/top-k by itself is expressly not the candidate.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: HyperNetworks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 生成整张主变换矩阵并在非线性两阶段链中执行。DCFormer生成head组合系数，Spline生成一元变换参数，FiLM是对角仿射；这里的每样本跨通道算子不受固定矩阵行缩放约束。与DFN迁为全连接后合并，不另计DFN。

cards.title: Liquid Time-constant Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 保留电容、漏电、状态/输入电导、反转电位和半隐式分母的完整微电路；不是单sigmoid gate或GRU替换。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Hamiltonian Neural Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: EA沿势能下降求汇总，Hamiltonian沿辛旋转梯度流动，连续精确系统不沿H下降；DEQ求平衡点，这里只取初值轨迹有限终点。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Lagrangian Neural Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 不是势能最小化或SPD协方差读出；必须包含速度Hessian、混合导数和线性系统解的Euler-Lagrange链。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Recurrent Equilibrium Networks: Flexible Dynamic Models with Guaranteed Stability and Robustness

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 旧DEQ对同一状态求无限深固定点且用隐式梯度；这里是有显式动态state的有限recurrent系统，每步内部非线性为下三角可前代计算，整体耦合H参数化控制增量行为。只用谱归一化RNN不能叫REN。

cards.title: Recurrent Independent Mechanisms

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: RRN每个节点共享LSTM并全部更新；Slot以共享GRU吸收竞争聚合；MAC一个控制/记忆链。RIM是互不共享转移参数的机制、top-k计算冻结和稀疏通信三件套；只加top-k attention不够。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Neural Production Systems: Learning Rule-Governed Visual Dynamics

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: NLM是arity/量词链，RRN同一消息函数并行全图，MAC全局control/read/write；NPS将规则身份与实体身份分开，经离散双阶段binding只修改指定变量，是路由执行链而非简单gate。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Dynamic Inference with Neural Interpreters

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 不是head混合：先推断变量类型，函数signature确定可访问变量子图，共享interpreter经code实现不同函数，再在计算深度复用函数。函数亲和性与code必须同时保留。
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: SympNets: Intrinsic structure-preserving symplectic networks for identifying Hamiltonian systems

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 与Spline都可逆但不是一元monotone spline：完整交叉坐标shear来自标量势的梯度，Jacobian满足JᵀΩJ=Ω，不是任意coupling或更深MLP。SPDNet是协方差流形变换。

cards.title: Coupled Oscillatory Recurrent Neural Network (coRNN): An accurate and (gradient) stable architecture for learning long time dependencies

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: 不同于RRN的LSTM消息，coRNN是具有位置/速度两态、恢复力和阻尼的二阶系统及半隐式更新；不能简化成单次tanh残差后叫振子。

cards.title: An evidential classifier based on Dempster-Shafer theory and deep learning

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: NetVLAD sums center residuals; VB capsules infer Gaussian assignments; RAT-SPN marginalizes a decomposable density. DST explicitly represents set-valued ignorance and incompatible mass through conjunctive fusion. Prototype distances alone do not qualify; all combination stages must remain.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: B-cos Networks: Alignment is All We Need for Interpretability

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Directional normalized transforms replace all internal affine/nonlinear layers; no content branch is merely rescaled by a scalar reliability head. Layerwise dynamic linearity is a mechanism of the entire branch.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Multiplicative Filter Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Withdrawn methods factor a finite bilinear/polynomial interaction of embeddings. MFN repeatedly reinjects nonlinear localized sinusoidal filters of the complete input and composes their product expansion. A single Gabor feature map followed by an MLP, or separate FourierNet and GaborNet counting, is not allowed.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Towards Certifying L-infinity Robustness using Neural Networks with L-inf-dist Neurons

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: NetVLAD pools residual vectors with soft assignments; here repeated learned-center maximum-distance maps define the network. There is no token clustering or normalization-only wrapper.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Sum of Squares Circuits

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: RAT-SPN uses nonnegative normalized mixtures without destructive cross terms. SOS combines signed amplitudes and contracts their squares, so marginalization requires cross-basis integrals. It is neither a new random SPN partition nor a compressed affine tensor-train layer.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Closest is CRATE, not merely RPCA. CRATE alternates subspace attention with a one-step nonnegative dictionary sparsification of current tokens. CPSS repeatedly pursues one original y, tracks explicit coding residual and exempts a growing estimated support from signed shrinkage. Hamburger factorizes a per-sample nonnegative matrix; RPCA separates lo
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Building Deep Networks on Grassmann Manifolds

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: SPDNet learns spectral functions of covariance magnitude; GrNet identifies a q-dimensional subspace modulo basis rotation and performs projector averaging followed by rank-q eigenspace selection. It discards basis choice, not the head labels used to construct each matrix.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Differentiable Compositional Kernel Learning for Gaussian Processes

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: RAT-SPN requires decomposable variable scopes and density leaves; NKN composes valid pairwise kernels with repeated overlapping input arguments and Schur products. OTKE uses a kernel inside balanced transport, whereas NKN learns the kernel algebra itself. Simple pair-dot readout lacks the entire composition network.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Convex Potential Flows: Universal Probability Distributions with Optimal Transport and Convex Optimization

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Spline updates alternating coordinate halves with monotone scalar splines; DEQ solves a fixed-point state. CP-Flow directly differentiates a global convex scalar potential to produce a coupled vector map. Its defining condition is Hessian positivity, not a contractive residual or numerical convergence to equilibrium.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: Neural Nearest Neighbors Networks

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Recursive relaxed selection without replacement and separate ordered neighbor volumes, rather than hard kNN EdgeConv, a single weighted average, or transport to a reference bank.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.

cards.title: PointCNN: Convolution On X-Transformed Points

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Dense neighborhood canonicalization followed by separable contraction, not EdgeConv max pooling or invertible coupling. Learned chart is an explicit adaptation, not source 3D geometry.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shared families allowed; distinct complete cores required.
